paragraphs: Chapter 845
Episode 210. Memories of the Past - Murakan(4)
"The Lord gave an order!?"
"Yes, he said to attack Elona Zipple."
Silderay's eyes widened.

Zipple was currently in a situation where Elona was being ostracized, leading to internal conflict. On the other hand, Runcandel, despite having lost a significant portion of its military force including the Ten Knights, still maintained a firm unity.
Due to Zipple's recent response to the surrender, their allies were also burning with more enthusiasm than before.
In such a situation, if Temar, looking like he used to and with his previous strength, participates in the war, he could easily turn the tables.
"Diana, are you saying that the Lord has improved that much?"
"He said he can fight for exactly three days... He plans to capture Elona during that time, and end the war."
It was Solderet who gave Temar these three days. It was a period created with the combined powers of him, the god of time Oltar, and the god of the eye, Azmil.
"…What happens after those three days?"
"The Lord will pass away. That's why there hasn't been any contact with the steward. He was preparing the Lord's grave with Solderet."
The death of Temar was still an established fact. Silderay was distressed by this fact, but it was a better situation than before, for both Runcandel and Temar.
"Murakan, did you hear that? Even though it's only for three days, the Lord will return as the person we knew."
"Ah."
"So try to gather your strength before then. It may be difficult to fight together because of your heart, but we have to witness the last flame of the Lord."
Murakan didn't reply, only blinking his eyes.
From that day, Temar's final order was delivered all over Huphester. All knights of Huphester were preparing for the final battle.
Furthermore, a surprising event also happened.
"Ho, the heart is really attached? It couldn't have been because of the prayer of the Holy King... It seems Solderet did something."
It was the words of the Eye Witch, the second Queen of Bows who came to check on Murakan.
"Really?"

"Perhaps? We can't know exactly unless we hear directly from Solderet or Murakan, Diana. Or maybe he's regenerating on his own after hearing that Temar could come back and fight for a few days. Anyway, it's a good thing. If the recovery continues at this pace, he might be able to participate in the decisive battle."
"Miracles are happening one after another as soon as the Lord tries to move. Thank you for coming to check, Queen of Bows."

"Thank you. Anyway, I also desperately hope that Murakan can participate. Right now, while Temar can fight, it's the only opportunity to capture Elona... it would be ideal if Murakan could fight as well."
Since giving his order, Temar had never once shown his face outside the storm barrier. Occasionally, the roar of Temar turned monster penetrated the barrier.
But Runcandel and the allies firmly believed that he would surely appear on the day of the decisive battle.
That belief soon became a reality.
November 20, 799.

The final decisive battle between the Huphester Alliance and the Lutero Magic Federation began. Huphester deployed its forces on all major magic towers of Lutero, led by each of the Ten Knights, and Lutero, in turn, positioned its wizards and dragons to counter them.
Naturally, the enemy territory assigned to Temar was the Tower of Story, the heart of Zipple.
He looked up at the Tower of Story, looking perfectly fine without any trace of demonization or ghostification.
The Huphester personnel stationed in the Tower of Story were only Temar, Diana, and Silderay. Lutero also had only Elona Zipple protecting the Tower of Story.
"What about Murakan?"
"He couldn't come, Lord. The Queen of Bows said his heart has recovered enough to fight, but he has significant mental issues."
"It was bound to happen. It would have been reassuring if he were here. Now all we can hope for is that he'll show up heroically when we're pushed back."
"...... Do you think we'll be pushed back? Lord, you are stronger now than I have ever seen you before. Yet Elona is in a state of exhaustion due to long torture and manipulation."
"Still, Elona came out to the Tower of Story alone to fight for Zipple. A monster who was just crazily strong now has will and determination. It would have been less burden if he was just stronger."
"Hoo, I don't understand. From Zipple's point of view, Elona would be the greatest war hero, but what could be the reason to continue fighting against us even after receiving such treatment."
"Blindness is like that. Aren't you the same, giving up more than you've gained in Runcandel, yet standing here to face the enemy with me?"
"I suppose that's true."
"Before I go to the grave, this is the only thing I can do for the family. Let's settle it in three days."
The moment Temar and the Ten Knights began fighting Elona, the other knights who were entrenched in Lutero also started their last battle.
It was neck and neck.
The early stages of the battle were literally neck and neck. All areas including the Tower of Story continued to fight evenly.
For a full 24 hours, there was not a single battlefield where the fight paused, even momentarily. Everyone was rushing to kill each other with bloodshot eyes.

Elona was not as destructive as before. Of course, her firepower was still superior to Temar and the Ten Knights, but it was clear that her strength was reduced compared to Elona before the infighting.

The Tower of Tales seemed to be unable to exert its powerful abilities as when it was turning Temar and the knights into wraiths. It was because the members of Ziepfel who feared Elona had severed some connections between her and the tower.
"I've never seen that monster looking this worn out. It's not the same, perhaps because she can't borrow the tower's power properly."
On the second day, Temar and the knights could see Elona panting.
The knights thought victory was at hand, but Temar was noticing elements they couldn't see.
"The tower will be activated soon..."
"Excuse me?"
"The Tower of Tales is slowly merging with Elona. This is unexpected. We need Murakan. Sildarei, tell the Vice Lord to bring Murakan."
"Understood!"
The Vice Lord was casting a barrier around the Tower of Tales. As soon as Temar and the knights inflicted a mortal wound on Elona, all the Vice Lords were set to enter a sealing stance.
And it was Temar's final role to cut off the sealed Elona's breath. Only Temar and Murakan could kill even the sealed Elona.
"Now? If I go get Murakan now, a gap will form in the barrier. Besides, we're not even sure if Murakan is in a state where he can fight."
"You were certain, my lord, that without Murakan's help, you would soon start to falter."
"Well, there's no helping it then. If we can't finish here, our Vice Lords will also have to face annihilation. I'll call Morte, go."
Murakan was blankly looking out the window.
Even after Sildarei and the Vice Lord arrived at the Garden of Swords, Murakan did not pay any attention to them.
"Murakan, the Lord needs you."
Strictly speaking, Murakan was not even aware that Sildarei and the Vice Lord were next to him. He was only awake, unable to distinguish his inner world from reality.
"Murakan, please. Pull yourself together......!"
Recalling the words Temar had entrusted him before he went to find Murakan, Sildarei looked at the unresponsive Murakan.
Even if Murakan cannot come, do not blame or criticize him. He has already managed beyond what he had to do.
But Sildarei couldn't accept it.
What's the point of miraculously recovered heart then? Sildarei screamed as he grabbed Murakan's collar.
"Wake up! Are you really going to let our lord's end be so futile? If only you would come with us, we can win. We can end this terrible war and return to our daily lives......!"

"Stop it, Sildarei. It seems we've taken a futile journey. From the beginning, the heart that was attached was not at the level that could exert the same power as before. Temar knew that fact from me, perhaps he just wanted to rely on Murakan. He's human too, after all."
"Murakan!"
"I... I can't... kill Temar."
"You should be killing Elona, not the lord!"
All that Murakan, who had barely opened his mouth, could do was to repeat the same words.

In the end, the two had no choice but to return to the battlefield, leaving Murakan behind. Even after they left, Murakan kept repeating the same words: he could not kill Temar, he could not kill his comrades any longer.
And so, the promised three days all passed by.
The war ended with the defeat of Runcandel. Murakan, unaware of the result, was abandoned in the Storm Castle. He was alone in a long and dark autistic state.
In December, on a day when a sharp storm poured over the Storm Castle, Murakan lost consciousness and collapsed. The heart that was momentarily attached in his chest was broken again and shaking.
The people who had desperately hoped that Murakan would participate in the last battle did not know.
In fact, Murakan was struggling to get out of his inner self all along.
All he needed was more time. Time to overcome his sorrow and return to reality, time to start over for those who had left first.
The temporary attachment of his heart was rather a result of him being further engulfed in his inner self.
The forcibly attached heart was even accelerating Murakan's complete extinction. The desire for extinction and the thought that he should stand up again were continually fighting within Murakan.

The fact that his heart was shattered again meant that his will to return to his remaining comrades was stronger. Even if he could not be with them when it was most desperate, even if he could not fight immediately.
"Ha, ha."
Murakan, who opened his eyes again, looked at the dark ceiling. Amid his blurred vision due to high fever, he could feel someone approaching the bed.
"Diana...?"
"Murakan, it's all over now..."
She did not resent Murakan. Not because it was Temar's command, but because she understood his situation.
She and the remaining comrades would soon disappear from the world.
But she knew that Murakan, with his battered body and mind, had to continue another lonely battle whose end was unknown.
Because she knew he was a person who could do it.
"Luckily, the lord's last fight caused a miracle. Meaning, we were able to avoid extinction. We have decided to form an alliance with Zipple."
"Uh, uh."
"Murakan, please forgive us... We have no choice but to entrust all the future to you."
"Don't go, Diana..."
"I'll be back. It's soon time for a meeting with Zipple. Rest, Murakan."
